verdict.rationale: Zulip's self-hosting option and data export/import tools imply full owner control over data location and lifecycle (docs-6, docs-8, docs-14, docs-25), which supports deletion/retention control indirectly. However, no evidence pack item documents explicit message retention policies, automated deletion, or per-user data-deletion APIs, so the specific 'retention and deletion controls' capability is unconfirmed.
